k8s-aiops v0.8.0

- Updated governance harness: all write tools now use risk-tier labels in audit logs, replacing previous tiering scheme.
- Revised documentation for clarity: audit and policy guardrails are now described as using token budgets and risk-tier labels.
- Improved compatibility and skill description: clarified audit labeling and focus on token/runaway budget controls.
- Removed obsolete documentation file (skill-card.md).

k8s-aiops 0.6.0 introduces diagnostic/RCA tools and expands governance:

- Added read-only diagnostic/RCA tools: pod-health and workload-readiness checks.
- Increased tool coverage to 55 MCP tools, including new diagnostics.
- New documentation on agent guardrails (see references/agent-guardrails.md).
- Improved CLI references and capability docs.
- Trimmed and clarified skill documentation; removed legacy skill-card.md.

k8s-aiops 0.3.0

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md with more details about usage, capabilities, and governance.
- Expanded descriptions of when and how to use the skill for common Kubernetes operations.
- Clarified out-of-scope scenarios and related skill routing for user guidance.
- No changes to code or features—documentation only.

k8s-aiops 0.2.0

- Major expansion: increases from 15 to 51 MCP tools, now covering advanced resources and operations.
- Adds support for listing/inspecting statefulsets, daemonsets, replicasets, jobs, cronjobs, ingresses, endpoints, configmaps, secrets (names/keys only), PVCs/PVs/storageclasses, and additional rollout controls (status, history, undo, pause/resume, set-image).
- New features: pod/node/namespace describe, top (metrics), and node drain are included.
- Enhanced namespace, job, and node operations, with reversible write/undo logic improved and high-risk operations clearly tagged.
- New onboarding wizard (`k8s-aiops init`) for easier context/target setup.
- Documentation and CLI references updated to reflect new capabilities; deprecated skill-card.md removed.
v0.1.0 first release: standalone governed Kubernetes ops — 15 MCP tools with built-in audit/budget/undo/risk-tier harness
